summary: Dfs::new premarks node 0 as discovered, so SCC's first pass skips it and can omit its component. Dfs::empty lets the first pass visit every node normally. The implementation reversal is valid, but no detecting upstream test was found. Source inspection of the only SCC test, scc in tests/ograph.rs, indicates that its updated graphs still recover node 0 during the second pass and produce the expected components under the reversal. Test selection is therefore blocked; no tests were executed.
